verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a genuine self-serve merchant path: onboard as a seller in the Dashboard, review and accept per-agent terms, publish a CSV product catalog via presigned-URL API, and receive human-approval-gated agent orders tagged in the Transactions page. However this is explicitly gated - Agentic Commerce Suite is private preview and restricted to US, Canada, and select European countries, and the custom ACP-style integration explicitly requires joining a waitlist rather than pure self-serve enablement. Missing for 10: evidence of unrestricted GA availability outside private preview, and a self-serve (non-waitlist) path for the custom checkout-endpoint integration.
